instruction: Search for arXiv papers about GPT-4 published on September 28, 2023, and add at least 2 papers to the spreadsheet with their title, arXiv link, and publication date.

parameters.window_name: New Large Language Models.xlsx - LibreOffice Calc

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding at least 2 arXiv papers about GPT-4 from Sept 28, 2023 and adding them to the spreadsheet with their title, arXiv link, and publication date. The evaluator extracts all paper rows and verifies that at least 2 valid papers are present that meet all criteria: contain arXiv links, have publication date of September 28, 2023, and are about GPT-4 topic.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly implements comprehensive verification: getter extracts paper data (title, link, date) from spreadsheet rows, metric validates each paper against all requirements

All instruction requirements are checked: arXiv link format validation (arxiv.org with /abs/ or /pdf/), date matching (Sept 28, 2023 with flexible format patterns), GPT-4 topic verification (case-insensitive matching)
Metric logic is sound: iterates through all papers, validates each against three criteria, counts valid papers, returns 1.0 only if at least min_new_papers (2) valid papers are found
Flexible date format handling: supports multiple date formats (2023-09-28, 09/28/2023, September 28 2023, etc.) using regex patterns
Postconfig properly saves file state: activates window, saves with Ctrl+S, ensures getter can read the updated spreadsheet
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor semantic consideration: evaluator checks total valid papers >= 2, not new papers added. If original file already contained valid papers matching criteria, user could add fewer than 2. However, this is unlikely given the specific date and topic requirements.
